note: Genome sequencing in children with severe sporadic DLD and normal non-verbal IQ identified a de novo TAF4 frameshift variant, expanding the TAF4 phenotypic spectrum.

evidence.text: A prospective trio-based genome sequencing study of 25 individuals with severe sporadic developmental language disorder and normal non-verbal IQ (non-verbal IQ >= 70) identified a pathogenic de novo frameshift variant in TAF4 (Gly171fs) fitting within the TAF4-related disorder spectrum.

source.title: Genome sequencing reveals high diagnostic yield in children with severe sporadic developmental language disorder

evidence.text: De novo putative loss-of-function variants in TAF4 cause a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by intellectual disability, abnormal behavior, and facial dysmorphisms.

source.title: De novo putative loss‐of‐function variants in TAF4 are associated with a neuro‐developmental disorder
source.quote: We here present a cohort of eight individuals, each carrying de novo putative loss-of-function (pLoF) variants in TAF4 and expressing phenotypes consistent with a neuro-developmental disorder (NDD).
